subject: Planning gates, sentinel scenarios, and QBR readiness
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Planning gates, sentinel scenarios, and QBR readiness

Team —

Kicking off the annual planning thread for FY28 targets and QBR readiness. I want to surface a tight set of planning gates and two sentinel scenario families that will drive allocations and guardrails. Goal is to finish the first pass of targets and runway assumptions by Apr 22 so we can hand to Finance for projections.

High-level asks: 
- Leadership: agree on 3 target bands (Base / Stretch / Protection) for revenue and ARR velocity.
- Ops/Eng: validate capacity assumptions (batching gains + dedicated slot commitments) that affect unit cost.
- Go-to-market: flag any major product-led cadence changes that would shift revenue timing.

Attached: planning timeline (tabbed) and a short primer on the sentinel scenarios we'll use. Please review and reply with the following by EOD Apr 8: 
1) One-line objections or missing inputs; 
2) Owner for each gate (see tab 'Gates'); 
3) Any accounting/recognition items to loop Finance on now.

I'll run a 30-min sync next week (invite coming). If you think we should expand scenarios beyond the two families below, call it out.

Sentinel scenarios (short):
A) Demand shock: lower growth by 25% for two quarters, test burn and hiring pause triggers.
B) Upside cascade: faster PLG conversion + two enterprise commits, test stretch hiring & budget reallocation.

Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Planning gates, sentinel scenarios, and QBR readiness

Marcus —

Thanks for framing. A few quick notes from the exec vantage: 
- I agree with the three-band approach. Please ensure we have explicit cadence for when we move an initiative between bands (who signs off).
- For Demand shock, include a conservative headcount runway (months of payroll) as an explicit gate. Finance will want that number in the first handoff.
- For Upside cascade, we should draft a lightweight reallocation policy (what can be shifted without board notice vs what requires board visibility).

I can own the 'Gates' owner nominations. I'll populate the sheet by Apr 9 and assign provisional approvers.

On the sync: make it optional for ICs — leadership only for the first 30. If we need cross-functional drilling, we add a follow-up.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO (interim)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 13:26:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Planning gates, sentinel scenarios, and QBR readiness

Adding GTM perspective —

Appreciate the clear gates. Two tactical items: 
1) Timeline: Revenue recognition quirks mean we need Finance to confirm the earliest date we can count certain ARR movements; I'll loop them in this week.
2) Pipeline sensitivity: for the Demand shock scenario, run a segmented sensitivity (PLG vs direct sales). The impact on timing is very different; please include a pipeline split in the 'scenarios' tab.

I've attached the current QBR deck template we use for customer-facing ops (we'll reuse slides for internal readiness). I can't open your planning XLSX on my phone but will review the primer.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
VP, Go-to-Market Operations

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 15:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Planning gates, sentinel scenarios, and QBR readiness

Thanks — some engineering constraints to call out: 
- Capacity assumptions need a clear default (conservative) path: assume no additional dedicated pools unless contracts signed. We should surface the marginal cost of burst vs committed slots per 10k tokens.
- Batching gain estimates are sensitive to prompt distributions; I'll run two profiles (conversational vs longform) and drop numbers into 'Capacity assumptions' by Apr 12.

Also suggesting an internal 'stress test' runbook for the Demand shock scenario: prioritized cut lists, freeze policy, and a communications checklist. I can seed that doc if folks want.

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
VP, Engineering

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 17:38:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Planning gates, sentinel scenarios, and QBR readiness

Great — appreciate the quick turn. Next steps captured below and I'll add owners in the sheet per Vivek's note: 
- Marcus: finalize timeline and send calendar invite for 30-min leadership kickoff (Apr 11, 16:00 PT).
- Vivek: populate gate owners by Apr 9.
- Jonas: capacity profiles by Apr 12.
- Marissa: confirm recognition constraints and loop Finance (cc'd finance.ops@acme-corp.com) by Apr 8.
- Grace: prepare a one-pager on OKR crosswalks to planning (how major roadmap asks map to target bands) by Apr 15.

I'll include the short runbook Jonas offered as an appendix for the Demand shock sentinel. If there are no objections, we'll treat the timeline as firm and move to the first handoff on Apr 22.

If CFO at Acme wants to meet, Marissa — introduce them to the Finance Ops contact in the cc.

Thanks all — see calendar invite.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
